contradictions.detail: The listing says the 4-speed M46 with overdrive came from a 1988 Volvo 245 donor. US 1988 240s used the M47 5-speed, and the seller concedes the transmission's origin is undocumented and may be a separate or earlier swap.

critical_evidence.evidence: The attached photos show the roof and C-pillars only at distance (front 3/4, rear 3/4, profile), with no visible bubbling at that resolution. There are no close-ups of vinyl roof edges, the rear window surround or C-pillar bases. The single underside shot covers only the rear axle area.
No compression, leakdown or cooling pressure-test figures. Donor mileage (~80k) is an unverified claim.

A photographed BAR Vehicle Information Label (1/29/2026) certifies a 1988 2.3L fuel-injected, manual CA configuration for this VIN, which covers the legal side. There are no receipts or photos of the swap itself (donor, mounts, wiring, dash/harness integration). The seller states there is no documentation of donor mileage or pre-install work.
The listing discloses a 'Title Only' notation on the California title. No title photo or DMV paperwork is among the attached photos.

The listing claims these items were replaced since 2025, with no invoices shown: brakes (pads, rotors, calipers, master cylinder), tie rods, springs, shocks, fan clutch, starter, battery, catalytic converter (Jan 2026), thermostat and tires. The seller states there are no transmission service records.

documentation.rationale: The identity half is present: VIN, a photographed BAR referee label tying the swap to this VIN, a disclosed title notation, and $0 dealer fees. The maintenance half is missing: no invoices for any of the claimed 2025-26 work, no swap receipts, no title photo, and no history report.

condition.rationale: Photos show straight gold paint, fresh-looking tires, a clean beige leather interior, a tidy engine bay, and a rear underside with only surface rust and no visible leaks. No faults are stated. Rust-critical areas (roof edges, C-pillars, rockers, spare well) were not examined here, and the respray could hide repairs.

price_value.rationale: No fair value or comps were supplied. The current $3,500 bid is early. An expected hammer of $7k-12k is modest for a manual Bertone, but the redblock swap, non-original dash and wheels, respray and 'Title Only' notation all discount value and narrow resale.

mission_fit.rationale: It is a manual car with a strong point of view, and the B230F/M46 is among the most robust, cheap-to-fix drivetrains available. Its bridge role is weakened by a 47-year-old body with unobtainable 262C-specific parts, a niche resale pool, and a title notation that may complicate a 6-24 month flip.

logistics.rationale: Montclair, CA is roughly a day's drive from Carmel. The car is CA-registered and BAR-certified, so smog and registration look feasible. PPI access before the Oct 1 close is not stated.

emotional_spec_fit.rationale: A rare Bertone body with a manual overdrive is a genuinely desirable trait. It is offset by the loss of the original PRV drivetrain and dash, a respray off the original color, aftermarket wheels with whitewalls, and a CarPlay retrofit.

evidence.mission_note: It is a genuine manual with a strong point of view and one of Volvo's most durable, cheapest-to-fix drivetrains, which fits the bridge brief on price and running costs. As a bridge, however, its resale in 6-24 months depends on a niche buyer pool, an unverified body, and a 'Title Only' notation that must be understood first.
evidence.rationale: This listing establishes identity well: the VIN is shown and a photographed CA BAR referee label (1/29/2026) ties the B230F/manual swap to this chassis. Photos show clean paint, a good beige leather interior, fresh tires, a tidy engine bay and a rear underside with surface rust only. What is observed as a problem is paperwork, not mechanics: a 'Title Only' notation on the CA title, no documentation for donor mileage or drivetrain work, an uncertain transmission origin conceded by the seller, and a donor odometer that makes 113k meaningless for the chassis. The substantial 2025-26 renewal list (brakes, springs, shocks, tie rods, cooling and starting items, catalytic converter) is claimed without invoices. The areas that decide a 262C's value — roof edges, C-pillars, rear glass surround and rockers — are not examined here in close-up. The respray before 2025 means body repair history is open. The drivetrain is the least worrying part of this car; the body and title are where evidence is needed.
evidence.next_action: Ask the seller, via BaT comments or direct contact, for the title photo, invoices, and roof/C-pillar/rocker close-ups, and confirm a PPI can be done near Montclair before the Thursday, October 1 10:44 AM close.
